item.title: 🌿🚶‍♂️ NEW TRAIL! EAST DON TRAIL ADVENTURE 🍪🥾 — Sat Aug 15, 11:00 AM
item.description:
Toronto Movies & Social Group - Celebrating 14 Years! # 🌿🚶‍♂️ NEW! EAST DON TRAIL ADVENTURE 🍪🥾
**Toronto's Newest Ravine Trail, Riverside Views & Fresh-Baked Cookies**
Have you walked Toronto's newest trail yet?
Join us as we explore the recently completed **East Don Trail**—one of the city's newest and most exciting additions to Toronto's incredible ravine system. Connecting communities that were once separated, this beautiful trail follows the East Don River through peaceful forests, wetlands, and scenic valley landscapes that many Torontonians have never experienced.
If you've done the Lower Don Trail, this is a completely different experience. Think quieter trails, beautiful river views, brand-new pathways, and the feeling of discovering somewhere new.

item.title: Guided Walking Tour Along The Front + Food/Drinks (Union Stn.) — Wed Sep 2, 5:45 PM
item.description:
Experience Toronto On **Wednesday, September 2nd**, **join me for this New Guided Walking Tour Along The Front provided by the Royal Ontario Museum.** The tour will start just west of the original Town of York, where we’ll explore the site of York’s original bustling market that continues to thrive today. On our walk we’ll encounter iconic and historic buildings such as the elegant Flatiron Building, the Royal York Hotel, spacious theatres, the breathtaking Galleria & more. One of the city’s earliest thoroughfares, the landscape of Front St. East has undergone many changes over the years. On our walk, we’ll see an examine these changes, including the new North Market building at St. Lawrence Market, and the renovation and restoration of Union Station and other buildings.
